# ARCH-9: The main loop never waits

Flight code does not block, busy-wait or sleep on the main thread; slow or waiting work runs as a state machine across calls or on another thread, periodic work runs at a rate set by its measured cost, and data shared between threads is protected (`WITH_SEMAPHORE`).

Confirmed 2026-10-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
